from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers = [color for color in colors if color != background]
    if not markers:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker = min(markers, key=lambda color: colors[color])
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-(r1-r0)+0):
        for c in range(w-(c1-c0)+0):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = marker
    return out
'''
